assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final illustration for a mobile app report banner, part of the four-image "Garden of inner processes" collection.
Style: exquisitely handcrafted matte modeling clay, real miniature stop-motion set, pressed leaf veins, gentle fingerprints, irregular soft sculpted edges, tactile earthy material, sophisticated art direction for an adult self-reflection app. Match a cohesive botanical clay world of oak leaves, acorns and brown branches.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas. ONE compact self-contained diorama, centered and fully visible with generous clear padding around ALL edges. Three-quarter elevated camera, consistent soft warm studio light from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion. Large clear silhouettes that remain legible at 170px wide. Keep all important objects within central 80% of canvas.
Palette: muted oak green, sage, warm ochre, terracotta and soft blue details. Studio backdrop is a uniform soft muted burgundy #582626 matching the app; no border, no frame.
Constraints: no text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark, people, faces, labels or UI. No glossy plastic, metallic objects, photorealistic plants, confetti, excessive tiny details, or luminous neon. All scenery including water and drops is visibly sculpted clay.

Subject: A terracotta oval footpath making a complete loop around a small sculpted oak tree on a low island of clay earth. Clearly visible repeated pairs of footprints travel around the loop. A single path branches OUT from the right side of the loop to a fresh small green sprout. Strong ring-shaped composition, ochre path, warm green oak canopy, a few fallen autumn leaves. Meaning: recurring life events, recognizing the loop and discovering another route.

Subject: One large soft-blue clay water droplet suspended above TWO broad sculpted oak leaves arranged as diverging chutes. The left curved green leaf guides a short trail of blue clay drops down to the roots of a healthy small sprout below; the right leaf tilts outward and lets drops fall off the edge away from the sprout. Minimal clear Y-shaped composition on a small earth base. Meaning: the same event, different reactions and consequences. Make the suspended source drop and leaf directions visually clear.

Subject: A small sculpted oak tree on a cross-section island of earth, with large exposed roots visible in the front. On the left roots connect to a small pool of soft turquoise clay water and that side of the tree has lively rich green leaves with a few honey yellow tips. On the right roots meet dry terracotta clay clods and two curled subdued ochre leaves. A flowing asymmetric composition, elegant and warm, the contrast is gentle not a dead tree. Meaning: what nourishes energy and what depletes it. Keep botanical clay detail large and readable.

Subject: Three broad rounded clay stone steps rising diagonally from lower left to upper right. Each step has one clearly pressed footprint in its upper surface. A young green oak sapling grows on the top step, and its brown clay roots visibly wrap around and bind the steps into a strong foundation. Large simple ascending silhouette on a low terracotta earth base, sandy ochre steps and restrained burgundy accents. Meaning: confidence and competence growing from accumulated small successes, experience as support.
